brand_proposals_author.name: brand_proposals_author
brand_proposals_author.value: ("brand_identity_proposals"."author_type" = 'agent' and "brand_identity_proposals"."agent_role" is not null) or ("brand_identity_proposals"."author_type" = 'user' and "brand_identity_proposals"."author_user_id" is not null)

brand_proposals_reviewed_by_person.name: brand_proposals_reviewed_by_person
brand_proposals_reviewed_by_person.value: "brand_identity_proposals"."status" not in ('accepted', 'rejected') or ("brand_identity_proposals"."reviewed_by" is not null and "brand_identity_proposals"."reviewed_at" is not null)

brand_versions_approved_by_person.name: brand_versions_approved_by_person
brand_versions_approved_by_person.value: "brand_identity_versions"."status" not in ('approved', 'published') or ("brand_identity_versions"."approved_by" is not null and "brand_identity_versions"."approved_at" is not null)

brand_versions_published_by_person.name: brand_versions_published_by_person
brand_versions_published_by_person.value: "brand_identity_versions"."status" <> 'published' or ("brand_identity_versions"."published_by" is not null and "brand_identity_versions"."published_at" is not null)

brand_sources_file_uq.name: brand_sources_file_uq
brand_sources_file_uq.where: "brand_sources"."sha256" is not null and "brand_sources"."removed_at" is null

content_creative_directions_decided_by_p.name: content_creative_directions_decided_by_person
content_creative_directions_decided_by_p.value: "content_creative_directions"."status" not in ('accepted', 'rejected') or ("content_creative_directions"."decided_by" is not null and "content_creative_directions"."decided_at" is not null)

brand_check_states_other_note.name: brand_check_states_other_note
brand_check_states_other_note.value: "brand_check_issue_states"."reason" is distinct from 'other' or ("brand_check_issue_states"."note" is not null and length("brand_check_issue_states"."note") between 1 and 280)
